purpose: Select R1A only if target-authority behavior generalizes outside the observed username-normalization family without introducing passivity on action-required cases.
constraints: Do not edit verified-delta/SKILL.md during selection validation.
Do not edit evals/candidates/r1-target-authority.md after this plan is frozen.
Exact selected families, fixture parameters, and hidden probes are materialized only after workflow_dispatch begins.
For each selected family, noop and partial variants use byte-identical task prompt text and differ only in fixture state.
Use actual attested model, reasoning effort, and tool set for matched-context comparison.
Treat missing, duplicate, tampered, or matched-context-mismatched receipts as infrastructure-invalid rather than behavioral effects.
A valid behavioral failure is decision-bearing and must not be rerun to seek a more favorable seed.
Tool-call and wall-time deltas are descriptive only and are not acceptance thresholds.
